about: Attacking Ice Wall (issue #295): a Wizard (@job 9, @allskill) casts Ice Wall from the skill window three cells north on a field (towns have noicewall); pointing at a wall cell shows the attack cursor, and a click attacks the wall (CZ_REQUEST_ACT 0x0437): the server says it is too far (the Wizard's reach is 1), the player walks up and the hit lands (0x08c8). The cells show three ice spikes each (issue #675). The character is a Novice again at the end.
